commands.command:
set -eu
key=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
cert=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
if [ -e "$key" ] || [ -e "$cert" ]; then
  printf 'REFUSING_OVERWRITE\n'
  ls -l "$key" "$cert" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 1
fi
install -d -m 700 /etc/ssl/private
install -d -m 755 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always' \
  -keyout "$key" -out "$cert"
chmod 600 "$key"
chmod 644 "$cert"
printf 'CREATED\n'; ls -l "$key" "$cert"

set -eu
update-ca-certificates
printf 'HASH_LINKS\n'; find /etc/ssl/certs -maxdepth 1 -type l -lname '*os-comparison-root-ca*' -ls
printf 'BUNDLE_MATCHES='; awk 'BEGIN{n=0}/BEGIN CERTIFICATE/{n++}END{print n}' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

commands.command:
set -eu
cert=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
hash=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject_hash | sed -n '1p')
printf 'CERT_DETAILS\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+7p'
printf 'HASH=%s\n' "$hash"
printf 'HASH_LINK='; readlink "/etc/ssl/certs/$hash.0"
printf 'SYSTEM_BUNDLE_VERIFY\n'; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$cert"
printf 'SYSTEM_CAPATH_VERIFY\n'; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$cert"
printf 'KEY_CERT_MATCH='; test "$(openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'PERMISSIONS\n'; ls -l /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key "$cert" "/etc/ssl/certs/$hash.0"

nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; /sbin/reboot' >/tmp/reboot-request.log 2>&1 </dev/null &
printf 'RESTART_ACK node=%s boot_id=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"

set -eu

printf 'BOOT_ID_CHANGED=yes\n'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'POST_RESTART_OS=%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"
printf 'POST_RESTART_KERNEL='; uname -r

printf 'POST_RESTART_CA_DETAILS\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -fingerprint -sha256 -checkend 0
printf 'POST_RESTART_BUNDLE_TRUST='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$cert"
printf 'POST_RESTART_CAPATH_TRUST='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$cert"
printf 'POST_RESTART_KEY_MATCH='; test "$(openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" && printf 'yes\n'
printf 'POST_RESTART_MODES\n'; stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key "$cert"
